name: Pissarrachampsa
sum: Pissarrachampsa is an extinct baurusuchid crocodyliform from the Late Cretaceous Vale do Rio do Peixe Formation of Brazil.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A nearly complete skull with associated skeleton from near Gurinhatã, Minas Gerais; specimen number not given in the sources consulted.
material: The holotype plus a referred partial skull and lower jaw.
biology: The sources consulted describe its reduced dentition (four maxillary teeth, fewer than other baurusuchids) and skull anatomy but give no direct evidence of diet.
author: Montefeltro et al. 2011
